issues.title: Truncated Build Script Logic
issues.why: The core build script (04-build-scripts.md) is truncated at the 90KB cap, leaving the Bash implementation and the final deploy logic undefined for the AI.
issues.fix: Move the Bash implementation of the build script to a separate file or ensure the overview provides a complete pseudo-code summary of the missing logic.

issues.title: Race Condition in Update Check
issues.why: AC-15 specifies updating 'last_check_unix' BEFORE spawning the child to prevent thundering herds, but does not define behavior if the child process fails to start or crashes immediately.
issues.fix: Add a requirement to reset 'last_check_unix' to 0 or the previous value if the detached process spawn fails.

issues.title: Ambiguous <module> Placeholder
issues.why: The ldflags in 04-build-scripts.md use a '<module>' placeholder which is not explicitly defined as the Go module path from go.mod.
issues.fix: Explicitly state that '<module>' must be replaced with the 'module' declaration found in the project's go.mod file.
